name: Resource Conservation Workshop
what_you_do: A week of field study, tours and hands-on sessions about saving natural resources. You also hear talks about college and jobs.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th to 12th graders from North Carolina.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was June 14-19, 2026. Applications were due in late March 2026 (deadlines vary by district). 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply through your local NC Soil and Water Conservation District. Deadlines differ by district. They are usually in late March. Contact the co-coordinators listed on the program page (Liz Driscoll, liz_driscoll@ncsu.edu, 919.886.3424).
notes: Dates are last year's. Awards and scholarships are given to students at the workshop.
